documents.title: Compare synthetic response-time phases
documents.text: Compare baseline and incident HTTP response durations measured using the same method. Check sample count and timing variation; a regression alone is not causal proof.

documents.title: Inspect synthetic dependency scope
documents.text: Review the Twin dependency path and compare observations on affected nodes. Topology reachability is not proof of a failing dependency.

documents.title: Verify a conditional synthetic model
documents.text: Compare the conditional target with a fresh observation from the same synthetic scenario. Record evidence before changing any hypothesis. Operational actions remain denied.
